product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Electric Automatic Can Opener with Auto Shutoff, Knife Sharpener, Cord Storage, and SureCut Patented Technology, Extra-Tall, Red
features: OPENS CANS THE FIRST TIME: This electric can opener has SureCut technology to easily align cans, ensuring cans open the first time, every time. No more struggling with cans when you're in a hurry to get a meal on the table.
EASY TO CLEAN: The removable cutting unit on the Hamilton Beach can opener makes cleanup simple. It's easy to detach and is dishwasher safe.
OPENS SMALL TO LARGE CANS WITH EXTRA-TALL DESIGN: With its extra-tall design, this automatic can opener easily opens a wide range of different-sized cans, including taller cans.
AUTOMATIC SHUTOFF. This Hamilton Beach can opener automatically shuts off, freeing your hands for other kitchen tasks.

BUILT-IN KNIFE SHARPENER & CORD STORAGE: The built-in knife sharpener keeps your kitchen knives sharp without having to buy a separate sharpening tool. The cord storage area helps reduce clutter on countertops and in cabinets.
description: Classic chrome Extra-Tall can opener. Entire cutting assembly is easily removed for dishwasher cleaning. Opens cans on the first try with Sure Cut action. Opens family size and extra large cans. Automatic shutoff for hands-free operation. Bottle opener. Knife sharpener. Cord storage/lock. Removable, washable cutting unit. Ul listed.
